extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x) = x^n, then f'(x) = nx^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx[cf(x)] = cf'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f'(x), the instantaneous rate of change of a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The operation of finding a derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Antidifferentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The inverse operation of differentiation; integration.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and antidifferentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function built from powers of x.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function of the form a^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Power function x^n
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The function x^n where n is a real exponent.

extracted_concepts.name: Real Exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An exponent n that may be any real number.

extracted_concepts.name: Integer Exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An exponent restricted to integer values.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiable Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function whose derivative exists.

extracted_concepts.name: e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The unique number for which lim_{h→0} (e^h - 1)/h = 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Exponential Function e^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The exponential function with base e.

extracted_concepts.name: General Exponential a^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An exponential function with base a.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ln a, used in the derivative of a^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The value approached as an input approaches a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit definition of e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Defines e by lim_{h→0} (e^h - 1)/h = 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Position Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: s(t), the position of an object over time.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: v(t) = s'(t), the derivative of position.

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of a derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal Cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: MC = C'(x), the derivative of cost.

extracted_concepts.name: Cost Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: C(x), a function representing economic cost.

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A derivative measuring change per unit.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the derivative to estimate function values near a known point.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative notation f'(x)
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The notation f'(x) for the derivative.

e is the unique number satisfying the limit condition.

A second derivative is the derivative of a derivative.
